Name: Mine Your Own Business (MYOB)
Author: GyGyaru
Description:
[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]

I made this because playing co-op with four people turned every mine run into a race. Whoever got to the floor first cleared all the ore, and everyone else got stuck looking at rubble.

With this mod each player gets their own copy of every floor. If two of you go down to floor 50 at the same time, you each end up on your own floor 50, with your own rocks, ore, monsters and ladders. You won't see each other down there, but nobody's stealing your iridium either.

The floors themselves are vanilla. Same layouts, same difficulty, same loot. The mod only changes who they belong to.

[size=5][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Your own version of every floor in the Mines and the Skull Cavern[/*]
[*]Coal carts and breakable barrels are per player too, so emptying yours doesn't empty your friend's[/*]
[*]Treasure chests on floors 10, 20, 30... work like vanilla: everyone gets to open their own once[/*]
[*]Ladders, shafts, the elevator and both cave entrances work exactly like before[/*]
[*]When you leave the mines your floors get cleaned up, so the host's game doesn't keep piling them up[/*]
[*]Does nothing in single player[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or newer[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer[/*]
[*][b]Everyone[/b] on the farm needs it installed, host and farmhands[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI if you don't have it yet[/*]
[*]Unzip the download into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Good to know[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Since everyone is on their own copy, you can't meet up inside the mines anymore. If you want to fight that slime together, you'll have to do it outside[/*]
[*]Skull Cavern floors are random, so your floor 130 and your friend's floor 130 won't look the same[/*]
[*]Mods that figure out the mine floor from the location name might get confused. Personal floors are named like UndergroundMine50@(player id). Mods that use the game's own floor number work fine[/*]
[/list]
Found a bug or a mod that doesn't get along with this one? Let me know in the posts tab.
